Hi Sara — great to hear, and thanks for the requirements doc.

Quick scheduling flag: EU moves clocks forward on 29 March this year while the US moves on 11 March, so the week of 22–28 March has a one-hour cross-region offset for some EU/US pairs. A single 90-minute global window is possible, but we risk starting at a local early hour for APAC attendees or creating confusion for EU folks if calendars show different local times.

Options I recommend (short):
- Option A: Two focused sessions (60 min EU/APAC-friendly + 45 min US-friendly) on the same or adjacent days.
- Option B: One 90-min session but we add a 30-minute "buffer" and publish both UTC and local start times explicitly; record and provide a tailored 30-min follow-up for APAC.

Marcus (SE) is looped in to confirm whether we should allocate a short pre-recorded SSO demo for APAC and how long the live Q&A will need. Laura from CS will help coordinate attendee lists and recordings.

I'll drop a tentative invite (two options) — please let me know constraint windows for London / New York / Singapore.

Thanks,
